about:
Woodward's Auto Spring Shop Inc., doing business as Woodward Auto Parts and King of All Parts, is headquartered in Cranston, Rhode Island. The company maintains two Massachusetts locations at 827 Church Street in New Bedford and 148 North Montello Street in Brockton. Founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The business operates as a wholesale distributor of automotive parts, serving commercial customers through an online platform called ePartConnection. The system allows wholesale buyers to place orders, view account-specific pricing, and check real-time stock levels. The company's product catalog is not detailed in available sources, but the trade names suggest a focus on suspension components and general auto parts.

Its customer base consists of wholesale buyers such as repair shops, parts retailers, and fleet operators in the New England region. The company does not list specific industry certifications or major client names in the provided materials.

The firm emphasizes digital ordering convenience for its wholesale accounts, though no further differentiators such as proprietary manufacturing, exclusive lines, or service guarantees are stated in the source information.
